scene.note: Some tests now wait for the store room list or the supplier, and your runner waits with them, but never forever.

steps.note: run() calls the poster paper test, and gets a promise back instead of an outcome.
The test reads the store room list. Only when that is read does it know if there are enough sheets.
run() writes the result only once the promise has settled, and main() waits for run() in turn.
Three tests that wait are next in the list.
The card paper test starts, and run() waits for it to finish before anything else starts.
Only then does the poster paper test start, even though the card test failed or passed long ago.
The results come out in the same order as the tests, and no two tests ever ran side by side.
The supplier test comes with its own time limit. Other tests get the usual one.
The test asks the supplier for a price. The workshop is offline, so no answer will ever come.
run() waits for the answer and the limit at the same time. The limit comes first.
The test fails with a timeout, the timer is cleared, and the next test runs.
